errors.text_span: Each chart is divided into two or three slices
errors.evidence: This is an inaccurate generalization. While three of the charts have two slices, the Gemini1.5-Pro chart has five slices.

errors.text_span: The Gemini1.5-Pro chart has four slices
errors.evidence: The Gemini1.5-Pro pie chart clearly shows five distinct slices, not four.
The description for the Gemini1.5-Pro chart omits one of the five slices shown: the light blue slice for "Ethical Advice" with a value of 14 (16.3%).

errors.text_span: visually ordered with the largest segment typically at the bottom-right
errors.evidence: This described ordering pattern is not present in the charts. In the GPT4-o chart, the largest slice is on the left. In the Llama3.1-70B-Instruct chart, the largest slice is on the bottom-left.
